t: The Nebo Lil Larry LED Torch is a compact, robust lighting solution. Utilising COB LED technology, this durable black aluminium torch provides bright, reliable illumination for a range of tasks. Its high and low area light modes cater for varied lighting needs, making it ideal for mechanics working in tight engine bays or for general use around the home or workshop. An emergency red flash mode adds a crucial safety element, perfect for distress signalling or enhancing visibility during roadside emergencies. The anodised aluminium body ensures impact and water resistance for tough environments. Supplied in card/paper packaging suitable for kerbside recycling.
